# Map values

# Compute neighbor averages (based on full original data)

    else:

# Prepare arrays
y = np.array([val[b] for b in boroughs])
x = np.array([neighbor_mean[b] for b in boroughs])

# Function to fit OLS and return params, residuals, std residual
def ols_stats(x_arr, y_arr):
    # simple linear regression
    n = len(x_arr)
    x_mean = np.mean(x_arr)
    y_mean = np.mean(y_arr)
    cov = np.sum((x_arr - x_mean)*(y_arr - y_mean))
    var = np.sum((x_arr - x_mean)**2)
    if var == 0:
        return None, None, None, None
    b1 = cov / var
    b0 = y_mean - b1 * x_mean
    pred = b0 + b1 * x_arr
    resid = y_arr - pred
    mse = np.sum(resid**2) / (n - 2)
    rmse = np.sqrt(mse)
    std_resid = resid / rmse if rmse > 0 else resid
    return b0, b1, resid, std_resid

threshold = 2.5
removed_history = []
